items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Jack Delaney, Raymond Boyk. Well, there's a lot of fellas that got their first start with Southland.

ctx.x: Like I said, right above Rapp, we've got Pete Fountain. And Almond Hogg right next to him. Under Almond is Raymond Boyk, another one of the true greats of New Orleans, Dixieland. And to the right of Raymond, we have Santo Pacora, another real great.
Let me interrupt about that picture in your other office. It's the poster, rather. I noticed it was dated up here at the Italian Hall at 1925. Do you know who played that dance?
